APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

LED shot glass

Outdoor Bars ↗

An acrylic shot glass with a lit base: A whole tray of shots goes out lit, and guests photograph it themselves.

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

After sunset in the lot, the lit base tells you where people are.

Yacht Parties ↗

Small, so a box of them lives in one drawer.

Confirm for your project

Check service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car；deck grip, how stable the shape is and the operator's container rules.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
